query: UPDATE refresh_tokens AS r SET revoked = true WHERE r.workspace_id = $1 AND r.token_hash = $2 AND NOT r.revoked AND r.expires_at > $3 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM refresh_families f WHERE f.workspace_id = $1 AND f.family_id = r.family_id AND f.compromised ) RETURNING user_subject, family_id
